name: accounts
sql: CREATE TABLE accounts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, balance INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: documents
sql: CREATE TABLE documents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL)

name: events
sql: CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, note TEXT NOT NULL)

name: events_by_account
sql: CREATE INDEX events_by_account ON events(account_id, id)
